purpose: Current complete registered CUDA suite outcomes and unresolved feature-family list. Historical raw runs remain immutable; append resolutions with their own identity and exact test outcomes.

scope.inventory_scope: CUDA registrations in the tested binary, across all registered areas; excludes unregistered/non-CUDA-source cases and standalone unsuffixed nvrtc test.
scope.optimization_policy: Existing tests retain their authored/default optimization; selected OptiX fixtures explicitly loop O0/O3. This is not a universal two-optimization suite.
scope.target_policy: RHI follows actual CUDA device capabilities, not the SM80 environment used by separate compiler gates.
scope.corpus_admissions: None; independent RHI suite, not automatic additions to the compiler working corpus.

reconciliation.duplicate_name_policy: Two cmd-copy-texture-offset-mip1.cuda registrations remain separate occurrences; source line assignment is ambiguous and is not inferred.
reconciliation.benchmark_terminal: benchmark-command.cuda includes an inline Duration message before PASSED; it is counted.

compiler_ownership.default: Shared createTestingDevice forwards the selected CUDA compiler. Passing a resource-only test does not establish NVVM shader execution; internal CUDA utility kernels retain direct NVRTC ownership.

custom_shader_routes.boundary: Secondary DeviceDesc omits compiler selection; custom device shader route is not forced by the suite selector.
Both replacement sessions at lines65/145 target PTX sm_5_0 without copying EmitCUDAMethod; both tests use precompileToTarget=false. Do not treat passes as guaranteed NVVM compilation.

compiler_ownership.cuda_external_device: All helper-created devices retain selection; its intentional wrong-context copy rejection is part of its passing oracle.
compiler_ownership.standalone_nvrtc: Unsuffixed direct NVRTC unit excluded by *.cuda selection.
